summary.text: The US Senate on Thursday night passed a sweeping, bipartisan bill to cut permitting timelines for energy and infrastructure projects. The vote was 62-33 and the bill was sent to the House. Some reports say it would make large data centres pay for the energy or grid upgrades they use.

conclusion.text: All sides report Senate passage of a sweeping, bipartisan permitting bill. Western outlets stress the vote, Trump's backing and House prospects, while Eastern outlets lead with data-centre costs and opposition. Whether it is already law differs between The Times of India and Western reports.
